sourceState: current files identified individually by MANIFEST.json

validation.workflow: synthetic browser demo plus local D1/R2 development

checks.scope: Payment start with injected storage failure, delayed response, visible feedback, retry, stable saved record version and single order; full UI roles rerun. API, calendar and startup suites from v1.6 were not rerun because their implementation did not change.

features: single question per view, mobile two-column choices, required-answer validation and progress
review/gateway/result demo payment with cancellation, resume, failure, retry and persistent receipt
doctor actions exposed beside collapsed clinical answers; explicit state-dependent guidance
transactional idempotent physician-to-coordinator task handoff, consent and role controls
coordinator completion propagates to member plan; member cannot complete team-owned action
admin support reply and resolution of ordinary issues
local browser upgrade preserves existing records
immediate payment progress label, local focused error feedback, no redundant saved-draft write or record refetch before checkout

publicBrowser.reason: Chromium does not trust the environment proxy CA; automatic approval review rejected a persistent trust-store addition. TLS verification was not disabled. Public HTTPS byte comparison succeeded; browser behavior was tested locally.

limitations: Real Android/iPhone camera and GPS not tested
Home visits remain demo-only; production provider/retention agreements not implemented
City starter catalog is not a nationwide official dataset
Public site uses browser-local storage; no shared cross-device patient database
SMS, banking, provider appointment confirmation and live medical operation remain unconnected
Startup improvement verified with controlled delays, not measured on user network
Exact no-visible-change symptom on user device not directly reproduced; reported URL matches the publication
